thread:
maya: Heads-up: product teams keep asking for quick SIEM dumps to investigate vuln findings. We need a hardened JIT export runbook (RBAC + KMS proxy + DLP + retention) that is fast but auditable. Thoughts? :eyes:

elena: I can draft. High level: ticket -> minimal fields -> automated DLP -> approver -> ephemeral RBAC + KMS-proxy unwrap -> export to secure bucket with TTL.

carter: Important: never grant kms:Decrypt directly. IAM grant should allow calling the proxy only. Proxy performs unwrap and issues a single-use artifact tied to ticket and expiry.

simon: Audit events must include ticket, requester, approver, unwrap_ts, object_sha256, dest_path, and dlp_summary. Ingest to immutable audit index.

maya: Can we standardize the ticket template so approvers have clear info?

elena: Proposed minimal ticket fields to copy into ops UI:

- Type: JIT-SIEM-EXPORT
- Requester: <okta_id>
- Ticket: INC-<num>
- Purpose: one-line justification
- Scope: explicit query or index paths and time window
- Fields: explicit CSV list (no wildcard)
- PII present: yes/no (list which fields)
- Retention requested: default 30d / up to 365d (legal signoff)
- Deliverable: masked-csv | secure-s3-link
- Approver: SOC lead alias

carter: Automation: label the IAM request ticket=INC-###; a controller will mint short-lived binding to role siem-analyst-jit for 2-6h. >8h requires manual SOC+legal signoff.

oncall: Approver flow: SOC lead gets a DM with details + Approve/Deny. Approve calls internal API to grant ephemeral token and posts an audit event. Deny returns a templated reason.

infra-bot: "audit:event created: export.requested ticket=INC-45121 requester=maya status=awaiting_approval"

simon: Pre-export checks: run DLP rules for private keys, AWS creds, bearer tokens. If DLP matches, block and surface hits to approver. Also enforce row and field caps: default max_rows=50k, explicit justification otherwise.

maya: Example KMS-proxy call we plan to use:

POST /internal/kms-proxy/unlock
{ "ticket": "INC-45121", "object_path": "s3://secure/exports/INC-45121/export.csv" }
Response: { "ephemeral_token": "tok_xyz", "expires_at": "2026-03-22T12:00Z" }

elena: DLP command for preflight (CI + runtime): `tools/dlp_scan --file /tmp/export.csv --rules dlp/default.json`. Exit code != 0 -> block. Include exact rule hits in ticket UI.

carter: Storage lifecycle: default bucket lifecycle delete after 30d. For evidence retention >30d, require legal signoff; moved to gated bucket with retention set up to 365d.

legal: Note: exports containing EU personal data must state region and retention. Prefer pseudonymized IDs. Legal signoff required for retention >30d.

simon: Manifest: exporter writes manifest with { ticket, manifest_ts, src_query, dest_path, object_sha256, dlp_summary } stored in audit bucket and linked to ticket.

oncall: Tests: add infra-ci integration test that simulates create ticket -> approve -> call kms-proxy -> run dlp (pass/fail fixtures) -> verify audit events and lifecycle. Owner?

carter: I'll own the IAM hook and CI test, aim to PR by Thursday.

elena: I'll draft the runbook with ticket template, approver checklist, DM payload examples, DLP rules, manifest example, and escalation contacts.

maya: Thanks. Final ask: include a brief approver checklist in the runbook: 1) confirm ticket scope 2) verify requester in Okta 3) ensure field minimization 4) confirm DLP pass 5) approve TTL and retention. We'll do a tabletop after PRs land. :lock:
